## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Code refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] `npm run type-check` passes with zero errors (strict TypeScript).
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with zero errors.
- [ ] I have verified domain neutrality (no narrow single-discipline bias introduced).
- [ ] Any new or modified user input handles sanitization properly.
- [ ] My changes do not introduce secret leakage or unencrypted client tokens.
